name: Zelophehad
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness

points: The Lord said the daughters of Zelophehad speak right: give them a possession of an inheritance among their father's brethren, and cause the inheritance of their father to pass unto them.

note.label: Numbers 27: The Daughters of Zelophehad and the Ordination of Joshua

points: The Most High affirms the tribe of the sons of Joseph: they have said well. The solution: the daughters of Zelophehad may marry whom they think best, only within the family of the tribe of their father.

note.label: Numbers 36: The Inheritance of the Daughters of Zelophehad

points: The daughters of Zelophehad did as the Lord commanded Moses: Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Noah married their father's brothers' sons, within the families of Manasseh, and their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father.

note.label: Numbers 36: The Inheritance of the Daughters of Zelophehad

points: Zelophehad the son of Hepher had no sons, but daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

note.label: Joshua 17: The Lot of Manasseh and the Blessing of Ephraim
